name: Randomizer
author: nerderror
description: Shuffles missions on the world map, fixed item rewards (optionally story key items, with logic), shop stock, enemies, enemy hats, weapon stats, projectiles, utility and ability stats, class perks, crew stats, prices, and for fun: dialogue, barks, names, music, mission lighting, weapon models, crew hats and NPC looks. Two presets: Balanced and Chaos, plus quick switches for all modes and for groups of options. Same seed = same game. Writes a spoiler log to SWH2ModLoader/Reports/Randomizer.

settings.label: Seed
settings.help: Leave empty for a random seed (it is saved after installing).

settings.label: Preset
settings.help: Sets all options below. Changing any of them by hand switches to Custom.

choices.label: Balanced — plays like the normal game

settings.label: All modes
settings.help: Switches the Mode of every option below at once, without turning anything on or off.

settings.label: Main
settings.help: Missions, item rewards, shops, enemies and enemy hats.

settings.label: Stats
settings.help: Weapon, utility, ability and crew stats, prices, class perks, projectiles; crew jobs, personal abilities, the new game start, the sub and loot decks.

settings.label: World map
settings.help: Whirlpools, world map loot, patrols and ambushes, hazards.

settings.label: Battles
settings.help: Enemy weapons and AI, explosive cover, mutators, chaos events, golden enemies and regional edicts.

settings.label: Cosmetic
settings.help: Light keeps the story readable: dialogue and names stay, the rest (barks, looks, hats, music, lighting, sounds, effects, voices) is shuffled.

settings.label: Shuffle missions on the world map
settings.help: Mission markers stay where they are, but start other missions. Story missions, bosses, heists, shops and missions holding story items stay in place.

settings.label: Shuffle fixed item rewards
settings.help: Mission loot, region bounties, world map artifacts/flagships, quest rewards.

settings.label: Shuffle story key items (with logic)
settings.help: Glow rods, heist keys, diving plates and the like move too, but only to places the story reaches earlier than their own, so the game stays beatable. Items the story hands out in cutscenes stay.

choices.label: Balanced (same kind and tier, from other shops)

settings.label: Randomize enemies
settings.help: Enemies in spawn tables (initial spawns and reinforcements) are replaced by enemies from the whole game, without repeats inside a table. Bosses and scripted enemies stay.

choices.label: Balanced (health & damage of the enemy it replaces)
Of the enemy it replaces (no infighting)

settings.label: Chaos limits
settings.help: Chaos stats only. Caps how much stronger an enemy can be than the one it replaces, and stronger enemies come in smaller numbers.

choices.label: Fair (health up to 2x, damage up to 1.5x)
Loose (health up to 3x, damage up to 2x)

settings.label: Shuffle enemy hats
settings.help: Enemies wear (and drop) each other's hats. Every hat still drops from some enemy.

choices.label: Balanced (damage, crit and random damage trade off, total stays)

settings.label: Shuffle class perks
settings.help: Level-up perks move between classes. The starting perk of each class stays.

choices.label: Balanced (same level, abilities with abilities, stat bonuses with stat bonuses)

settings.label: Randomize utility stats
settings.help: Grenade damage and radius, repair amounts, charges and cooldowns, and the bonuses of boots, armor, scopes, cogs, jetpacks...

choices.label: Balanced (stronger or weaker, and the price follows)

settings.label: Variance ±%
settings.help: Also used by Chaos ability stats.

settings.label: Randomize ability stats
settings.help: Cooldowns, charges, damage, healing and range of class and personal abilities, and their cog cost.

choices.label: Balanced (one step stronger costs one cog more, and the other way round)
Chaos (every number on its own, cog cost 0-5)

settings.label: Randomize crew stats
settings.help: Health, cogs and move distance of every crew member (not the captain).

choices.label: Balanced (one trade-off each, e.g. +2 health for -1 cog)

settings.label: Shuffle weapon projectiles
settings.help: What player weapons shoot: lightning, lasers, fire, arcing banjo shots... This also changes range and arcs.

settings.label: Shuffle whirlpools
settings.help: Whirlpools lead elsewhere, but never to a region the story hasn't opened yet, and never deeper or into another sea's blockade. The way to Atomic City stays.

choices.label: Chaos (across seas, back to earlier ones)

settings.label: Shuffle world map loot
settings.help: Coins, big chests and fragment caches floating on the map swap places.

settings.label: Shuffle patrols and ambushes
settings.help: Enemy ships and turrets placed on the map become other ones of their kind, and roaming spawns bring other ships. Story ships and bosses stay.

settings.label: Shuffle hazards
settings.help: Spike rocks and sea mines trade places. Geiger zones and rust pools stay.

choices.label: Balanced (as many rocks and mines per region)
Chaos (every spot a rock or a mine)

settings.label: Shuffle enemy weapons
settings.help: Enemies carry each other's guns (model, projectile, sound and damage come with the gun). Bosses, turrets, drones and mechs keep theirs.

choices.label: Balanced (similar damage, held the same way)

settings.label: Shuffle enemy AI
settings.help: Who keeps their distance, who rushes in, who hides. Bosses and special enemies keep theirs.

choices.label: Chaos (also melee rushers, berserkers and cowards)

settings.label: Explosive cover
settings.help: Explosive barrels become random kinds (fire, ice...), and in some missions all low cover explodes.

choices.label: Balanced (1 in 5 missions has exploding low cover)
Chaos (half the missions, hanging cover too)

settings.label: Mutator roulette
settings.help: Each mission gets its own modifiers: double tap, slippery enemies, everyone explodes... They are announced at the start and shown on health bars.

choices.label: Balanced (half the missions, one mild mutator)
Chaos (every mission, one to three of any)

settings.label: Chaos events
settings.help: At the start of your turn something may happen: adrenaline, a stunned enemy, a mutiny, a teleporter glitch, the alarm...

settings.label: Golden enemy
settings.help: A random enemy is golden (tougher) and drops a prize when scrapped. The prizes are in the spoiler log.

choices.label: Balanced (half the missions, a rare item of the mission's tier)

settings.label: Regional edicts
settings.help: Each world map region has its own edict (Chunky, Deadly, Vectron Shield...), issued by the strongest enemy of its missions, for every faction.

settings.label: Shuffle starting jobs
settings.help: The job a crew member joins with (their default weapon).

choices.label: Balanced (jobs swap, every job is still there)
Chaos (any job, some may be missing)

settings.label: Shuffle personal abilities
settings.help: Crew members' own abilities, like Daisy's stun gun, move to other crew members.

choices.label: Chaos (first and second on their own)

settings.label: Random start
settings.help: A new game starts with random money, a random weapon and a random utility.

choices.label: Balanced (a little money, a tier 1-2 weapon)
Chaos (up to 400 money, fragments, any weapon)

settings.label: Shuffle sub weapons
settings.help: Your ship weapons fire each other's guns, and enemy ships swap guns. Bosses keep theirs.

settings.label: Shuffle sub upgrade costs
settings.help: Fragment costs of sub upgrades swap inside each tech tier.

settings.label: Randomize loot decks
settings.help: How often each kind of loot drops (guns, utilities, money...). Resets the loot decks of existing saves.

settings.label: Shuffle dialogue lines
settings.help: Lines in conversations and cutscenes are swapped. Choices and tutorials are not touched.

settings.label: Shuffle battle barks
settings.help: Short lines crew and enemies shout in battle.

settings.label: Shuffle NPC looks
settings.help: Bartenders, shopkeepers and townsfolk in bars and on locations swap models. Characters used in cutscenes keep theirs.

settings.label: Shuffle crew hats
settings.help: Every crew member wears another crew member's own hat.

settings.label: Shuffle weapon looks
settings.help: Weapon models and icons swap; stats stay with the weapon.

choices.label: Any weapon (a hammer may look like a rifle)

settings.label: Shuffle music
settings.help: Mission music, world map music of the regions, and the songs of the bar bands.

settings.label: Shuffle mission lighting
settings.help: Lighting, sky and background of missions.

choices.label: Same kind of place (navy ship with navy ship...)
Anything (Atomic City light in the Arctic)

settings.label: Shuffle names
settings.help: Names of items and enemies, in every language. Descriptions stay, so read those!

choices.label: Same kind (weapons with weapons, enemies with enemies...)
Everything together (an enemy called Repair Kit)

settings.label: Shuffle sounds
settings.help: Weapon shot, aim and reload sounds, and the hurt sounds of bots.

settings.label: Shuffle effects
settings.help: Bullet trails, muzzle flashes, impacts and death effects. Only the looks change.

choices.label: Balanced (trails with trails, impacts with impacts)
Chaos (a bullet may look like an explosion)

settings.label: Shuffle voices
settings.help: The talking voices of characters.

settings.label: Mystery items
settings.help: Names and descriptions of weapons and utilities become ???. The stats are still shown.
